title: 第7章 道试夺魁第8章 修仙十次第
content_zh:
仙塾的白玉台阶上，老夫子鹤发童颜，道袍拂过石阶，带起细碎的流光。
他手中拂尘轻挥，台中央凭空浮现出一块丈高的测灵玉，玉面莹润，隐有云纹流转。
“道试开始。”老夫子声音不高，一声令下，却是全场寂静，“能引动测灵玉光者，方有入塾资格。”
事关自身的修仙道途，长生之业，可以说人生命运中最重要的转折点，任是谁，此刻也不免带上了几分紧张。
“道试有二，一测根骨，二测仙基！二者具备，才堪堪有望仙途，不然终究如水中月，镜中花，一场梦幻而已。
而这种根基浅薄之辈，正道无望，白费资源，我大更仙塾是绝对不收的，老老实实去当个不入流的散修，死了正途之心。”
仙塾老夫子的话，冷得似是结了冰，不容丝毫人情温度。
修仙的残酷，在这一刻，给所有人都上了一课。
吴燃灯若有所思。
除了陆家陆明轩，方家方婉，乐道司乐菡这三个仙族领头子弟面带轻松，似乎成竹在胸，毫无担心之外，其他之人无一例外，都脸带忧虑之色。
“陆家子弟，先来。”
陆明轩当仁不让，上前一步，自信将手掌按在测灵玉上。
不过片刻，玉面竟浮现出一座玲珑剔透的琼楼，飞檐斗拱、窗棂雕花，每一处细节都栩栩如生，仿佛下一秒就要从玉中飞出。
灵玉瞬间亮起璀璨的金芒，光芒中浮现出细密的刻痕，像无数把小刻刀在石上流转。
“上品金灵根，还有金刀妙手的根骨，不错，不错。”老夫子抚须点头，“心手合一，能雕金石，可塑万物，是为妙手。你陆家这一代倒是出了个不错的后辈。”
“多谢夫子！”陆明轩态度恭敬，脸上露出得意之色，瞥了眼角落里的吴燃灯，嘴角扬起轻慢的弧度。
“不愧是少爷！”其他陆家人见到自己少爷先拔头筹，顿时大受鼓舞，精神一震，纷纷上前。
“伪灵根！不合格！”
“铜皮铁骨？这种傻大粗，跑去做练武的莽夫，别来这丢人现眼！”
“中品土灵根？血气枯竭，分明是暴食禁药废丹，消耗寿命伪造灵根之辈，也来滥竽充数，滚下去！”

……
老夫子话语似刀，尖酸刻薄。
那些陆家弟子各个昂首挺头上去，心如死灰下来，哪怕侥幸有真灵根堪堪过关的人，也没得到丝毫好脸色。
直到……
一个书卷气女子手掌刚触到灵玉，玉面就泛起层层叠叠的药香，连空气里都飘着薄荷与艾草的气息。
不过数息，测灵玉上便浮现出数十种药草虚影，从常见的当归、黄芪，到珍稀的雪莲、朱果，每一种都标注着药性与生长习性，清晰无比。
“水土灵根！百草之体。”仙塾老夫子这才颔首，露了点好脸色，“水土相生，灵根可为上品。更有宝体，能辨百草，善识药宝。灵根和宝体相辅相成，女娃子你在丹道上大有前途！”
“多谢夫子点拨！”方婉屈膝行礼，衣袖轻扬间，带起一阵沁人心脾的药香，身姿清雅，赫然一派药王世家传人的气派。
随后就是乐律仙族的司乐菡，她抱着片刻不离手的古琵琶，指尖未触琵琶弦，只凝神静气。
片刻后，测灵玉上竟流淌出清越的乐声，时而如高山流水，时而如金戈铁马，余音绕梁，三日不绝。
灵玉立刻腾起团清越的乐音，像玉佩相击，又似风铃轻响。
“余音异灵根。天音之骨。”老夫子眼露赞许，“以音通神，以声感应，音道炼心，亦可御敌。了不起，了不起。你司乐一族真是代代皆有才人出！”
一改之前的冷漠，这一次老夫子却是大加赞赏。
可见这乐道异灵根真是非同一般，就连那之前大放光彩的陆明轩、方婉也被比下去一头。
他们二人对视一眼，面带凝重，但仍是笑脸相迎。
“菡妹妹，你藏得可真够深的。身怀余音异灵根，以后你的仙乐恐怕在南山郡无人可比了！”
content_en:
On the white jade steps of the Immortal School, the old master has fair hair and a childish face, and his Taoist robe brushes over the stone steps, bringing up tiny streams of light.
He waved the fly whisk lightly in his hand, and a piece of jade that measured the spirit appeared out of thin air in the center of the stage. The jade surface was shiny and smooth, with hidden cloud patterns.
"The Taoist test begins." The old master's voice was low, and when he gave the order, the whole place fell into silence, "Only those who can induce the spirit-testing jade light are qualified to enter the school."
It can be said that it is the most important turning point in one's life and destiny as it relates to one's own path to immortality and immortality. No matter who you are, you can't help but feel a little nervous at this moment.
"There are two Taoist tests, one is to test the bones, and the other is to test the immortal foundation! Only if you have both, you can hope for the path to immortality. Otherwise, it will be like the moon in the water or the flowers in the mirror, just a dream.
As for people with such shallow foundations, there is no hope for the righteous path, and they are a waste of resources. My Dagengxian School will never accept them. They will just go and become unskilled casual cultivators, and they will give up on the righteous path. "
The words of the old master from the Immortal School were as cold as ice and did not tolerate any human warmth.
The cruelty of cultivating immortals taught everyone a lesson at this moment.
Wu Randeng was thoughtful.
Except for Lu Mingxuan of the Lu family, Fang Wan of the Fang family, and Lehan of the Ledaosi family, the three leading disciples of the Immortal Clan, who had relaxed expressions and seemed to have everything in mind, without any worries, everyone else, without exception, had worried expressions on their faces.
"Children of the Lu family, come first."
Lu Mingxuan did his duty, stepped forward, and confidently pressed his palm on the spirit-detecting jade.
But for a moment, an exquisite and clear Qiong Tower appeared on the jade surface, with cornices and brackets and carved window lattice. Every detail was lifelike, as if it would fly out of the jade in the next second.
The spiritual jade instantly lit up with a bright golden light, and fine carvings appeared in the light, like countless small carving knives running on the stone.
"The top-grade golden spirit root, as well as the bones of the golden sword master's hand, are good, not bad." The old master stroked his beard and nodded, "The heart and hand are united. They can carve gold and stone, and shape all things. They are masters. Your Lu family has produced a good descendant."
"Thank you, Master!" Lu Mingxuan's attitude was respectful, with a proud look on his face. He glanced at Wu Randeng in the corner, and raised the corner of his mouth with a contemptuous arc.
"As expected of the young master!" The other Lu family members were greatly encouraged when they saw that their young master was the first to take the lead. Their spirits were shaken and they stepped forward one after another.
"Pseudo spiritual roots! Unqualified!"
"Copper skin and iron bones? This stupid, thick and reckless man who goes to practice martial arts, don't come here and embarrass yourself!"
"Mid-grade earth spiritual root? The blood is exhausted. It's obviously the result of overeating forbidden medicines and discarded elixirs. People who have consumed their lifespan and forged spiritual roots are also here to make up for their losses. Get out!"
…
The old master's words were sharp and sharp.
The disciples of the Lu family held their heads high and felt as if they were dead. Even those who were lucky enough to have true spiritual roots and could pass the test did not feel good at all.
Until...
As soon as the palm of a bookish woman touched the spiritual jade, the jade surface was filled with layers of medicinal fragrance, and even the smell of mint and mugwort floated in the air.
Within a few breaths, dozens of medicinal herbs appeared on the spirit-measuring jade, ranging from common angelica and astragalus to rare snow lotus and red fruit. Each one was marked with clear medicinal properties and growth habits.
"The spiritual root of water and soil! The body of hundreds of herbs." The old master from the Immortal School nodded and showed a good face, "Water and soil are in harmony with each other, and the spiritual root is the best. There is also a treasure body, which can distinguish hundreds of herbs and is good at recognizing medicinal treasures. The spiritual root and treasure body complement each other. Girl, you have a great future in the alchemy path!"
"Thank you for your advice, Master!" Fang Wan knelt down and saluted, her sleeves fluttered slightly, bringing out a refreshing scent of medicine. Her posture was elegant, and she looked like a descendant of a family of medicine kings.
Then came Si Lehan from the Musical Immortal Clan. She was holding the ancient pipa that she never left her hand for. Her fingertips did not touch the strings of the pipa, and she just concentrated on her breathing.
After a while, clear music flowed from the spirit-testing jade, sometimes like mountains and rivers, sometimes like gold and iron horses, and the lingering sound lingered for three days.
The spiritual jade immediately made a clear and clear music, like jade pendants striking each other, and like the sound of wind chimes.
"The lingering soundAlien spiritual root. Bone of Tianyin. "The old master's eyes showed approval, "Use the sound to communicate with the spirit, use the sound to sense, the sound can train the mind, and it can also defend against the enemy. Amazing, amazing. Your Si Le family is really full of talents from generation to generation! "
After changing his previous indifference, this time the old master was full of praise.
It can be seen that this Le Dao spiritual root is really extraordinary, even Lu Mingxuan and Fang Wan, who had shined before, were outclassed.
The two of them looked at each other solemnly, but still smiled at each other.
"Sister Han, you hide it really deep. With the lingering spiritual roots, your celestial music will probably be unparalleled in Nanshan County from now on! "
